title: Profile event v1
description: ProfileUpdated, which the Profile service publishes after every change to a runner's profile: a save, a visibility change, a photo attached or removed. Exchange `cra.events`, type `topic`, durable; Profile declares it on every connect. Routing key equals `eventType`. Each message is persistent JSON, `contentType` `application/json`, with `messageId` equal to `eventId`. Profile writes the event in the same transaction as the change (a transactional outbox) and relays it every two seconds, oldest first; a publish is done only once the broker confirms it and did not return it, so an event published while no queue is bound for it waits in the outbox, as it does while the broker is unreachable. Consumers must be provisioned before events can leave the outbox. Delivery is at least once: deduplicate by `eventId`. Each event is a full snapshot of the runner's public card, so a consumer replaces its copy rather than merging: it applies an event whose `payload.revision` is at least the one it holds and ignores a lower one. `npm run events:republish` (in the image, `node dist/republish-events.js`) sends every profile's current card again, each under its unchanged revision, with fresh `eventId`s and one `correlationId` for the run. Revisions restart at 1 when Profile's database is reset or re-seeded (`npm run db:reset`, `npm run db:seed`), so a consumer's copy must be reset with it.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Deduplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the change was saved, or when a republish ran. ISO-8601, UTC. Order by `payload.revision`, not by this.

correlationId.description: The X-Correlation-Id of the request that made the change; one fresh UUID per run of the seed or the republish command.

payload.description: The runner's public card, plus the profile's revision. Every key is always present: a field the runner hid, or never set, is null — gear included, never []. `id`, `name`, `area`, `areaCell` and `revision` are never null; `photoUrl` is null without a photo. The exact point and the hidden set are never here.

id.description: The runner's id: Identity's, in lowercase.

area.description: The name of the place the runner usually runs, such as "Lumphini area".

areaCell.description: Roughly where: the runner's point rounded to the nearest 0.01° (about 1.1 km in Bangkok). Never the point itself.

photoUrl.description: The photo's public address; it needs no token.

paceMin.description: Decimal minutes per kilometre, the faster end, kept to the nearest second.

paceMax.description: Decimal minutes per kilometre, the slower end.

revision.description: 1 when the profile is created, one more with every change.
